gloss: to hesitate; to be reluctant; to refrain from

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {憚|はばか}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to hesitate; to be reluctant; to refrain from
definitions.explanation: to hold back from doing something out of consideration, propriety, or fear of consequences
to exercise power or influence without restraint (often in the set phrase {憚|はばか}ることなく)

examples.japanese: ⟦{人目|ひとめ}→人目：17973_hitome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{憚|はばか}る。
examples.english: To be mindful of others' eyes (to act discretely).

examples.japanese: {憚|はばか}り⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I humbly venture to say (with all due respect)...

examples.japanese: ⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{憚|はばか}って⟦{公表|こうひょう}しなかった→公表する：21375_kouhyou⟧。
examples.english: They didn't make it public out of concern for public opinion.

examples.japanese: {憚|はばか}ること⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: He stated his opinion without hesitation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{憚|はばか}らない⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧だった。
examples.english: It was an attitude that didn't shy away from criticism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{憚|はばか}ること⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧だった。
examples.english: She was a journalist who spoke out without being intimidated by those in power.

notes:
Sense 1 is hesitation out of respect or a sense of propriety: one holds back because of what others will think.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{人目|ひとめ}→人目：17973_hitome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{憚|はばか}る: to avoid being seen, to be wary of others' eyes
- ⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{憚|はばか}る: to be mindful of public opinion
- {憚|はばか}り⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: if I may be so bold (a humble lead-in to a presumptuous remark)
- {憚|はばか}ること⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ / {憚|はばか}らず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: openly, without restraint
- ⟦{憎|にく}まれ→憎む：00318_nikumu⟧っ{子|こ}⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{憚|はばか}る: a disliked person thrives in the world (sense 2, a proverb)

TRANSITIVITY:
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for what one is wary of (⟦{人目|ひとめ}→人目：17973_hitome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{憚|はばか}る).

USAGE:
Formal and literary. In speech, ⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}する→遠慮する：19518_enryosuru⟧ is the everyday word for holding back.

WATCH OUT:
お{憚|はばか}り is a dated euphemism for the toilet.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ためらう / ⟦{躊躇|ちゅうちょ}→躊躇：07722_chuucho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hesitate, from doubt rather than propriety
